preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 500,000.
There are exactly n-1 edges in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid nodes.
There are exactly n decoration labels.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in decorations)
preconditions.description: Each decoration label is between 0 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(set(decorations)) == len([a_i for a_i in decorations if a_i != 0])
preconditions.description: No label appears more than once among the non-zero decorations.

postconditions.description: The result is a non-negative integer less than 1000000007.
The result is the number of possible configurations of the tree modulo 1000000007.
